kamloops.title: Video captures Faulder residents rescuing their dogs from vehicle surrounded by flames
kamloops.description: A video has surfaced online that captures the dramatic moments when Faulder residents were trying to rescue their dogs from a vehicle that was surrounded by flames.

kamloops.title: ‘Explosive’ Summerland wildfire creating conditions ‘never seen before’
kamloops.description: The BC Wildfire Service says it is one of the most challenging fires this province has ever faced, involving helicopter rescues of dozens of people trapped behind the fire line.

kamloops.title: As massive B.C. wildfire raged, groups worked to rescue livestock, animals
kamloops.description: When the Bald Range wildfire sparked near Summerland on Friday afternoon, thousands of residents prepared to leave their homes. But many have livestock and animals to care for.

kamloops.title: RCMP report a possible fatality from massive Summerland fire
kamloops.description: RCMP said officers continue to provide emergency response and assistance following the Bald Range fire that grew quickly and forced thousands to flee their homes.

kamloops.title: Summerland wildfire forces large numbers of seniors in residential care to relocate
kamloops.description: David Hickey, a driver with the High Acuity Response Team, helped receive dozens of seniors at Kaigo Senior Living Facility in Kelowna.

kamloops.title: Video shows rapid night growth of Bald Range fire near Summerland
kamloops.description: The Bald Range fire, which sparked around 5:30 p.m., grew so fast that homes were destroyed and the fast-moving flames trapped people.

kamloops.title: Photos of Bald Range fire near Summerland show aggressive wildfire growth
kamloops.description: The Bald Range wildfire near Summerland sparked at 5:30 p.m. on Friday and exploded in size to 9,500 hectares by Saturday morning.

all.title: B.C. premier declares wildfire state of emergency
all.description: B.C. Premier David Eby and emergency officials are set to provide an update Saturday as wildfires continue to force evacuations across the province.

all.title: Over 20,000 flee as B.C evacuation orders in full swing due to aggressive wildfire
all.description: The BC Wildfire Service says it's displaying aggressive rank 5 behaviour, with an organized flame front with a fast rate of spread and moderate to long-range spotting.
